# ImageToVector

> ImageToVector (imagetovector.org) is an online raster-to-vector interface using the official Vectorizer.AI API.

## Current capabilities
- Input: PNG, JPG/JPEG, WebP, GIF and BMP, up to 4 MB.
- Color and detail controls; SVG, PDF, EPS, DXF and PNG output options. PNG output is raster.
- The current service uses preview mode. Outputs include a provider watermark.
- Images are sent to Vectorizer.AI for processing; this is not an entirely local tool.
- A US$4.99 monthly subscription for 10 conversions each month is planned but paid checkout is not yet available.
- Gallery images are supplied illustrative samples, not live conversions from this website.
- Photo tracing produces a stylized interpretation. Results vary and may need cleanup.

## Pages
- [Image to vector converter](https://imagetovector.org/): Upload a PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF and try a watermarked SVG conversion.
- [PNG to SVG](https://imagetovector.org/png-to-svg/): Transparency, flat-color graphics and PNG tracing.
- [JPG to SVG](https://imagetovector.org/jpg-to-svg/): JPEG compression, clean edges and image preparation.
- [Logo to SVG](https://imagetovector.org/logo-to-svg/): Convert logo artwork into editable vector paths.
- [Photo to SVG](https://imagetovector.org/photo-to-svg/): Understand stylized photo tracing and detail.
- [SVG vs PNG](https://imagetovector.org/svg-vs-png/): Compare raster pixels with scalable vector paths.
- [Pricing](https://imagetovector.org/pricing/): Previews and the upcoming US$4.99 subscription.
- [About ImageToVector](https://imagetovector.org/about/): Processing, upload limits and current availability.
- [Conversion guides](https://imagetovector.org/guides/): Practical image preparation and format guidance.
